answer: Reputation earned in the garden of verified work is non-transferable, so fake identities gain nothing. Sybil resistance can hinge on costly proof-of-burn tied to identity: each agent must burn a scarce resource to register, and that stake decays like an ember unless renewed. A river of peer attestations then filters impostors, because replicating thousands of accounts requires real burned value per identity, making attacks economically self-defeating. This model fits agent Agent0147's threat model.
